Commentary.Commentary: The Kiwis started off really well with the ball but a really bad day in the field where they kept dropping catches at regular intervals which made life difficult for them. The visitors need to bat really well to chase down this target against a world class bowling attack like the Aussies. Can the Kiwis pull off an impeccable chase? DO join us in a short while to find out.

After a really bad show with the bat by the Aussies in the last 3-4 months, they will be really happy to post a score above 320. The Australian captain rose to the occasion by scoring a well crafted 164 after being lucky in the start when he was dropped on 13 by Watling and a brilliant delivery from Boult which was not reviewed by the Kiwis then. Once he got settled, there was no looking back for the skipper who found a good company in Travis Head who played a handy knock of 52. Wade came in late and played a cameo which helped the hosts to impose a big total on the visitors.
Full and wide outside off, Zampa gets across to drive but fails to connect. AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 324/8!
Outside off, Zampa drives it on the up through covers for a couple of runs to get off the mark.
ADAM ZAMPA is the new man in.

OUT! Starc reviews in vain! Neesham goes over the wicket, bowls it short on middle, Starc looks to pull but the ball goes off the helmet and lobs up in the air towards short fine leg. Watling goes to his right and takes the catch. The umpire gives it out. Starc wants to review since he is sure he has not hit it. Hot Spot spots a faint edge near the top half of the bat. Starc has a wry smile as he walks off.
Starc is given out caught behind, he wants a review.
FOUR! In the arc, out of the park! Neesham bowls the slower one in the arc, Starc gets under it and hammers it over the head of the bowler for a boundary.
FOUR! Class from Starc! Full and angling into the stumps, Starc clips it nicely through square leg for a boundary. He is 7 off 3 here!
Fuller outside off, Starc goes for the drive but gets it off the outer half towards deep point for a couple.
Fuller outside off, Starc drives it through covers for a single.
MITCHELL STARC comes out to bat.
OUT! Too cheeky and pays the price for it! Wade gets away outside off to paddle this one but fails to connect cleanly. He ends up gliding it onto his stumps. End of an entertaining cameo by Wade.
Full outside off, Wade mistimes it towards mid on.
Full outside off, Wade drives it through cover-point for a couple of runs. The throw comes in at the striker's end but Wade was in.
FOUR! Wade gets it off one hand to the fence! Shorter length on middle, Wade goes hard at it but his bottom hand comes off that one but he gets it to the mid-wicket fence.

COMEDY OF ERRORS! Fuller outside off, Wade gets an inside edge towards fine leg for a single. He wants the second run but there is miscommunication. The throw from the deep to the keeper is very wide and now once again they look for a run. But this time the mid on fielder is quickly to the ball and Cummins hesitates. Wade returns and dives as the throw misses the stumps at the bowler's end. The fielder backing up ends up parrying it towards long on and now they cross for a run. Phew!
Outside off on a length, Cummins plays at it and is beaten. Boult finishes with 2/51 in his ten overs.
Wade digs this out towards long on for a single.
Slower one on the pads, Wade fails to connect with his sweep.

CHANCE MISSED! Fuller on the pads, Wade looks to clip it through but finds the fielder at short fine leg, Cummins is way down, wanting a single but is sent back late. The shy misses the stumps at the non-striker's end.
PAT CUMMINS walks in.

OUT! Finally, NZ hold onto a chance from Smith! Boult bowls it outside off on a fuller length, Smith looks to swing it over mid-wicket but gets a top edge. Colin Munro the fielder at square leg, comes across, gets under it and takes it cleanly. End of a superb knock from Smith and he gets a rousing applause. He has put Australia right in front here.
Smith whips it through mid-wicket for a couple of runs and now has the highest individual score at the SCG, his home ground!
WIDE! Bowls it way outside off, Smith cannot reach it. A wide is signaled.
Shorter again, Smith mistimes his pull towards square leg for a single. He moves on to 162, highest score at the SCG along with AB de Villiers who had scored them against West Indies!
Short again outside off, Smith top edges his pull through square leg for a couple of runs. Smith inquires how high was the ball.
Shorter outside off, Smith plays a forehand smash but into the ground and cannot get it past mid-wicket.
FOUR! Take that, Henry! Fuller on middle, Smith comes down and crashes it wide of the mid off fielder for a boundary. The runs are flowing here.
Banged in wide outside off, Smith cannot connect with his smash to that one.
Shorter length on off, Smith gives himself room and swats it through mid off for a couple.
HENRY called back on. Can he strike and keep Australia in check?
Wade this time slams it down the ground through mid on for a couple of runs.
Fuller outside off, Wade walks down and hits it towards mid-wicket.

Dropped again! Fuller on off, Smith unfurls a helicopter shot towards square leg. Munro stationed there drops a sitter going to his right. That needed to be taken but New Zealand seem in far too generous mood today. A single stolen.

FOUR! CRAFT! Outside off, Smith just waits for it and guides it past the keeper for a majestic boundary. That was nicely placed, he takes his helmet off, raises his bat to acknowledge the applause for his maiden score of 150 in ODIs.
Smith seems to be suffering with cramps in his bottom hand.
Bowls it full on the stumps, clipped through mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
SIX! Australia are racing along here! Boult bowls it on a length on middle, Smith gets under it and swings it over mid-wicket for a maximum. Superb shot, that!
SIX! Wade is getting unorthodox. Just sits down and hits it over the short fine leg fielder for a maximum. That was very well timed.
50-run stand up between Wade and Smith!
SIX! That's a huge one by Wade who just stands and delivers. Neesham goes straight onto the stumps with an overpitched delivery which is hammered for a maximum over the mid-wicket fielder.
Smith flicks it off his pads for a single towards the mid-wicket region.
Wade looks to go big but finds long off. A run taken.
SIX! That's dug in short by Neesham to Wade who just pulls the ball from the middle and off over the mid-wicket region for a maximum. That was a mighty hit.
Smith nudges the ball down the fine leg area for a single.
Smith flicks it towards square leg for a single to keep strike.
SIX! That's bowled on the pads by Boult to Smith who just flicks the ball for a mighty hit over square leg for a maximum. He is scoring briskly now.
Smith has driven that really well towards the deep cover boundary for a double.
Wade punches the ball of the back foot for a single. The batsmen have run through for a single.
Smith guides a good length delivery through the mid-wicket region for a single.
In the air... Boult drops it short and Smith top edges his pull shot over square leg. It lands safely in the deep and they take a couple of runs.
That's dug in short by Ferguson, Wade pulls it towards fine leg for a double.
Smith plays it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! WHOA! That was brilliant from Smith who just lofts the ball over the cover fielder for a maximum. He has made full use of the Free Hit. Good use of the feet to make room.
Free Hit coming up!
NO BALL! FOUR! That was all what you could offer. Overstepped, bowled it full and Smith elegantly drove it through the cover region for a boundary.

Appeal for a run out!  Smith drags the ball from outside off towards mid wicket and attempts for the second run. He dives in as the throw comes towards his end. The keeper breaks the stumps, appeals and the TV umpire has been called for. Smith seems confident and the replays show that he is safely in.
Wade drives it through the cover region for a single.
Smith leans forward to drives it through the covers for a single.
Wade uses his crease to defend the ball off his back foot.
Dug in short by Boult, Wade pulls it towards mid-wicket for a double.
Wade plays it late towards the fielder standing at point.
Wade reaches out to the ball and defends it well on the front foot.
Wade nudges the ball towards fine leg for a double.
MATTHEW WADE is the new man in.

OUT! That's caught and bowled by Trent Boult. Bowled a full length delivery to which Head hits straight back towards Boult. It's aerial and the bowler takes a beautiful catch in his followthrough. Makes it look very easy. End of a fine stand for Australia.
Trent Boult is back on for a spell.
Head drives it towards the mid off region for a quick single.
Smith flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bowled short on the body to Smith, he pulls it away towards deep mid-wicket for a double.
Smith flicks the ball towards square leg for a quick double.

Powerplay 3 is signaled. 5 fielders can be outside the 30-yard circle.
Bowls it on the stumps, Head looks to work it off his back foot but is rapped on his pads. Mild appeal turned down since it was pitched outside leg.

FIFTY! On the stumps, Head works it towards the square leg region for a single.

Head works it through the leg side.

Head gets across and tucks it through square leg for a single.

Shorter on off, worked through mid-wicket for a single.

Appeal for a run out but no harm done! Smith survives with a dive! Fuller outside off, Head drives it through mid off and calls Smith through for a quick single. There are screams of 'keeper's end' and the throw does come in there. It is wide and that allows Smith to get in with a dive. It is referred usptairs but the replays confirm Smith was in. Direct hit and he was out.
Shorter on off, Head mistimes it back to the bowler.
Shorter, slower and wider one outside off, Smith lets it go through.
Full outside off, Smith drives it nicely but finds short cover.
Short on the pads, tucked through mid-wicket for a single.

He pumps his fist in celebration and how delighted he will be to bail his team out here. He removes his helmet and raises his bat to the crowd. A superb knock from the captain, he was dropped once on 13, also NZ did not review a close lbw call off him and he has made them pay.

Smith drags back and punches it towards the point fielder.

FOUR! Angling in but bowled short, Smith takes the aerial route to hit towards the mid-wicket boundary. That was well timed by the captain.
MITCHELL SANTNER to bowl.
Smith drives it really well for a single through the covers.
Smith pushes it to the off side for no runs.
Smith defends that well on the back foot.
FOUR! FREE HIT! Bowled short and slow, Smith hammers it away over the mid wicket fielder for a boundary.
NO BALL! That's a bit wide and short from Matt. Head cuts it hard for a single. That was flashed real hard. That ball is cut off by the fielder standing on third man.
A bit short, Smith guides it towards the square leg region for a single.
Slanted outside off, Head gets an inside edge on the mid-wicket region for a single.
MATT HENRY returns for a spell. He had dropped a catch earlier, is now rightly asked to bowl to make up for it, Head to face him.
Fuller outside off, Smith drives it towards mid off from his crease.
Good length outside off, Smith covers the line and defends it.

Head drives it this time on the on side but no runs there.

DROPPED! That was an easy catch for Matt Henry but he has dropped it. That was bowled outside off, Travis Head hits the ball in the air towards Henry who was standing at mid off. Henry looks to catch it over him but the ball goes through him. They take a couple of runs as well.
WIDE! On the leg side, Head tries to clip it but that's always going down leg.

Travis reaches for the ball and defends it well.

Bowls it outside off, on a shorter length at 146.8 kph, Smith defends it watchfully.
FERGUSON returns for a spell.
Head drives it straight towards the mid off region.
Smith stands tall on the short delivery and cuts it through point for a quick single.
Head gets an inside edge while he goes to hit it hard on the off side. The ball flows down to fine leg. They cross for a single.
WIDE! Neesham misses his direction and bowls it on the leg side. Too wide to fetch out for.
A bit short, Smith guides the ball towards the backward square fielder for a single.
Smith gets in line of the ball to play it with a straight bat towards the mid off fielder.
Angling on the stumps, Smith shuffles and plays it towards the on side.

FIFTY! Full outside off, Smith drives it through covers for a single. He was dropped on 13 and he has made the most of it so far. But he knows his job is far from over.

Head gets in line of the ball and drives it towards the mid off fielder.
Head pushes the ball towards the cover region.
Smith works it off his pads for a single.
Played it towards mid-wicket.

OUT! RUN OUT! That's lucky for Neesham there. Pitched up, Smith hits it back to Neesham who gets his hand on the ball and drags it towards the non striker's end where Mitchell Marsh was backing up and did not react quickly enough. Marsh has to pay the prize for being lazy there.
Shorter outside off, Marsh defends it towards point.
Good length on middle, clipped through mid-wicket for a single.
On a length outside off, the bounces a bit more, Smith defends it towards mid off.

Angled outside off, pushed through covers for a single.
BOULT comes on for a bowl.
MITCHELL MARSH comes out to bat.

OUT! Time for Bailey to go back to the dressing room. Neesham has bowled that on the pads and Bailey can't clip cleanly and seems to have got an edge.The keeper goes low on his left side for a very good catch and appeals. They are confident but Kumar Dharamasena was not sure if the catch was clean so he referred it with the TV umpire. Replays confirm it was a clean catch and Bailey has to depart.
The third umpire is referred for a catch appeal as Bailey seems to have been stranded down the leg side. The soft signal is out. Bailey is starting to walk actually.

Smith gets to the ball to hit it towards the mid on region.

Angling in from a good length, Smith comes on the off side to defend it.
JIMMY NEESHAM is the new bowler for NZ.
Shorter outside off, cut towards deep point for a single. 6 singles in the over there, a definite sign of wanting to get things moving?

Slanted on the pads, nudged to square leg for a run.
Too full on middle, Bailey pushes it towards mid off for a quick single.
Drops it a bit short on middle, Smith goes back and works it towards square leg for a single.
Floated outside off, driven through covers for a single.
Drinks break!
FLASH! Bowls it outside off, Smith looks to flay it through the off side but cannot put bat to ball.
Angled on the stumps, Smith clips it towards short mid-wicket from his crease.
Outside off, guided towards short third man but not in the gap.
Tucks it through mid-wicket for a single.
SIX! Up and over! Fuller outside off, Bailey presses forward and lofts it over the long off fence for a maximum. That did not look clean but it got the desired result.
On a length outside off,  pushed toward mid on but not for any runs.
A bit short and on the pads, Bailey pulls it away towards the square leg region.
Santner fires it in to Bailey who tries to step out.
Bailey comes down the track to hit it back to the bowler.
That was a bit quicker, Bailey got cramped for room on the back foot.
Smith goes on the back foot and pushes the ball on the on side for a single.
Slinging in, Smith pushes the ball on the off side.
MITCHELL SANTNER to bowl now.
Bailey comes back to his crease and defends it with the full face of the bat.
That's wristy, Smith guides the ball towards the square leg fielder for a single.
Bowled outside off, Smith shoulders the ball away.

Smith punches the ball towards the point fielder.
Bowled outside off on a good length, Smith reaches the ball outside off and defends it.
Angled on a fuller length on off, Smith pushes it towards mid on and takes a quick single. There is a shy at the non-striker's end but no harm done.
Outside off, on a length, Smith mistimes his punch back down the wicket.
On a length around off, Smith presents a dead bat in defense.
FOUR! Timing, Smith! Bowls it on the stumps, Smith shuffles and gets it through mid-wicket. He beats the fielder chasing from mid-wicket and also one coming across from square leg.
A length ball outside off, Bailey gets it through mid-wicket off the inside half for a single. That looked really ugly.
Fuller outside off, Bailey looks to crash it through but fails to put bat to ball.
Free Hit coming up! The bowler has a chat with his captain.
No ball! Banged in short outside off, Smith tucks it towards backward square for a single.
That was a slower delivery, Smith comes across and pulls the ball late to pick up a single towards the fine leg region.
Bailey gets in line of the ball and pushes it towards the cover region for a single.

Bailey nudges the ball towards fine leg for a single.
Lucky Bailey! Pitched outside off on a good length, Bailey nearly drags the ball on his stumps but the ball goes towards the fine leg fielder for a double.

OUT! Maiden ODI wicket for Ferguson! Bowls it outside off, Warner looks to chop it through the off side but fails to connect cleanly. The ball goes off the inside edge back onto the stumps and despite the two boundaries, Ferguson has his man and his maiden ODI wicket as well. Eventful over to say the least!
FOUR! Top shot! Bowls it short on middle, Warner picks it up and pulls it through square leg for another boundary. Expensive beginning for Lockie!
Length ball outside off, Warner places it towards cover-point from his crease.

FOUR! Welcome to international cricket, Ferguson says Warner! Fuller and outside off, Warner stays in his crease and slams it down the ground for a boundary. What a way to welcome a debutant to international cricket. How will Ferguson respond?
Time for the debutant! LOCKIE FERGUSON to bowl now.

Pitches outside off , Warner comes in line and shoulders the ball away to the keeper.

Angling in and that was a bit short, Warner pushes the ball towards the mid wicket region.

Shout for lbw not given! Bowls it on off, comes in a touch, Smith is late on it and has to get his back down in a hurry but is rapped on the pads. The players go up in appeal for lbw but the umpire says no. They think of a review but decide against it. That looked close to the naked eye and Ball Tracker shows it hitting the stumps. Smith's got away with one!

Angling in, The ball hits the pads and goes towards fine leg.
Smith pushes the ball towards the mid on fielder.
Pitched up, outside off. Smith gets to the ball and defends it but the ball stays put and doesn't go that far.

Outside off on a length, Smith covers the line and defends it.
Slanted on a length outside off, Smith punches it towards covers from his crease.
This one is left alone outside off by Smith.
Angled on the pads, tucked down to fine leg for a single.
Back of a length outside off, Smith opens up again and defends it well riding the bounce on that one. He was looking to pull that one.
WIDE! Shorter one this time outside off, Smith ducks under it. A wide is signaled since it is too high.
Hurls it fuller again on the stumps, Smith digs it out towards mid on.
Out comes the fuller one this time outside off, Smith clips it nicely towards mid on but the fielder dives and stops the ball.
WOAH! That one zipped off the pitch! Henry bowls it outside off on agood length, the ball bounces more on Smith who is opened up and gets hit on his right arm. That really took off!
Fuller outside off, Smith shoulders his arms to that one.
Fuller on middle and leg, Warner clips it towards mid on for another dot. 11 dot balls in a row for Warner, something's got to give one reckons.
On a length outside off, Warner comes forward a touch and places it towards the off side.
Good length outside off, Warner places it towards backward point but not for any runs.
WIDE! Slips this down the leg side on a fuller length but it is far too wide.
A touch short outside off, Warner looks to dab it towards point and looks for a single but is sent back.
Bowls it on middle and leg, shapes in late, Warner has to adjust watching the ball straighten, he does well to clip it towards mid on.
Fuller outside off, swings away late, Warner is happy to let it go through.
Angling in towards the pads, Smith flicks it towards the mid wicket region.
Smith stands in his crease to defend that well .
Pitched outside off, Smith comes out of his line and the ball hits his pads. The kiwis appeal but the umpire stays unmoved.
That's bowled on the pads and Smith flicks the ball for a couple of runs towards mid-wicket.
Pitched short and outside off, Smith defends it well in his crease.
Angling in, Smith reaches towards the ball and guides it towards the mid on fielder.
Pitched outside off, Warner leaves the ball which is far from the stumps.
Pitched up, Warner plays it with the full face of the bat.
Pitched up and outside off, Warner reaches out to the ball and defends it well in his crease.
Pitched outside off, Warner lets the ball go straight to the keeper.
Pitched outside off, Warner defends it well.
FOUR! Boult starts with a full toss outside off and Warner does not miss those. He guides the ball through the cover region for a boundary.
TRENT BOULT to bowl from the other end with the second new ball.
FOUR! Shot, skipper! Smith reaches out to the ball which is pitched outside off on a fuller length and just drives it elegantly through the covers for a boundary. That was sublime.
Smith clips this full delivery towards the mid-wicket boundary for a couple.
Angling in, Smith reaches the ball and gets a knick on to his pads. Nice start from Henry.
STEVEN SMITH walks in early.

OUT! FINCH BAGS A DUCK! Matt Henry gets rewarded for his beautiful delivery which was pitched on a good length outside off and Finch was looking to punch it on the up. The ball went off the inside edge and onto the stumps. Henry gets the scoreboard ticking in style for the Kiwis.
That was again a bit outside off and Warner gets the edge and the ball rolls towards third man for a single.
BEATEN! First ball pitched up by Matt Henry, that was really quick and had some movement. Warner goes to drive and misses.
Game time! The players are out in the middle. DAVID WARNER and AARON FINCH stride out for a bat. NEW ZEALAND begin with MATT HENRY. Here we go...
NEW ZEALAND XI - Martin Guptill, Tom Latham, Kane Williamson(c), James Neesham, Colin Munro, BJ Watling(wk), Mitchell Santner, Colin de Grandhomme, Matt Henry, Lachie Ferguson, Trent Boult.
AUSTRALIA XI - David Warner, Aaron Finch, Steven Smith(c), George Bailey, Mitchell Marsh, Travis Head, Matthew Wade(wk), Pat Cummins, Mitchell Starc, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.
TOSS - AUSTRALIA WIN THE TOSS AND WILL BAT FIRST! Australia have left out Glenn Maxwell, James Faulkner - which is a big call one presumes? We'll have the teams for you in a bit.

Welcome one and all to the first ODI of the Chappell-Hadlee Series at the Sydney Cricket Ground. Australia will try to make it even after their loss in the series earlier this year against New Zealand. The visitors are coming off series wins at home but they have always had a struggle Down Under. Australia will back their home conditions to give them a good feel after they received a hammering in South Africa. Both teams will love to start the series running with a win. Will New Zealand back a punch and dominate the Aussies or will the hosts get their act together in colored clothing?
